question: On which day did God create man in His own image?
ref_kjv: So God created man in his own image, in the image of God created he him; male and female created he them. And God blessed them, and God said unto them, Be fruitful, and multiply, and replenish the earth, and subdue it: and have dominion over the fish of the sea, and over the fowl of the air, and over every living thing that moveth upon the earth. And God said, Behold, I have given you every herb bearing seed, which is upon the face of all the earth, and every tree, in the which is the fruit of a tree yielding seed; to you it shall be for meat. And to every beast of the earth, and to every fowl of the air, and to every thing that creepeth upon the earth, wherein there is life, I have given every green herb for meat: and it was so. And God saw every thing that he had made, and, behold, it was very good. And the evening and the morning were the sixth day.
explanation: God created man in His own image, and the evening and the morning were the sixth day.

question: What did God call the dry land?
ref_kjv: And God called the dry land Earth; and the gathering together of the waters called he Seas: and God saw that it was good.
explanation: "God called the dry land Earth; and the gathering together of the waters called he Seas."

question: What did God call the firmament?
ref_kjv: And God called the firmament Heaven. And the evening and the morning were the second day.
explanation: "God called the firmament Heaven." That was the second day.
hint: It was made on the second day.

question: For how many days and nights did it rain in the flood?
ref_kjv: And the rain was upon the earth forty days and forty nights.
explanation: "The rain was upon the earth forty days and forty nights."

question: Of what wood did God tell Noah to make the ark?
ref_kjv: Make thee an ark of gopher wood; rooms shalt thou make in the ark, and shalt pitch it within and without with pitch.
explanation: God said, "Make thee an ark of gopher wood."

question: Which bird did Noah send out first?
ref_kjv: And he sent forth a raven, which went forth to and fro, until the waters were dried up from off the earth.
explanation: Noah sent forth a raven, which went forth to and fro.

question: Before God showed him the stars, whom did Abram name as the steward of his house?
ref_kjv: And Abram said, Lord GOD, what wilt thou give me, seeing I go childless, and the steward of my house is this Eliezer of Damascus?
explanation: Abram said, "The steward of my house is this Eliezer of Damascus."

question: How did Abram respond to the promise of descendants like the stars?
options: He asked for a sign in the sky
ref_kjv: And he believed in the LORD; and he counted it to him for righteousness.
explanation: "He believed in the LORD; and he counted it to him for righteousness."

question: In the vision before the stars, what did God say He was to Abram?
options: His shield and exceeding great reward
answer: His shield and exceeding great reward
ref_kjv: After these things the word of the LORD came unto Abram in a vision, saying, Fear not, Abram: I am thy shield, and thy exceeding great reward.
explanation: "Fear not, Abram: I am thy shield, and thy exceeding great reward."

question: Into what did Joseph's brothers first cast him?
ref_kjv: And they took him, and cast him into a pit: and the pit was empty, there was no water in it.
explanation: They cast him into a pit; the pit was empty, with no water in it.

question: In whose house did Joseph first serve after he was sold into Egypt?
ref_kjv: And Joseph was brought down to Egypt; and Potiphar, an officer of Pharaoh, captain of the guard, an Egyptian, bought him of the hands of the Ishmeelites, which had brought him down thither. And the LORD was with Joseph, and he was a prosperous man; and he was in the house of his master the Egyptian.
explanation: Potiphar, an officer of Pharaoh, bought Joseph, and Joseph was in the house of his master the Egyptian.

question: In what did Joseph's brothers dip his coat?
options: The blood of a kid of the goats
answer: The blood of a kid of the goats
ref_kjv: And they took Joseph’s coat, and killed a kid of the goats, and dipped the coat in the blood;
explanation: They killed a kid of the goats and dipped the coat in the blood.

question: What did the LORD use to drive the sea back all night?
ref_kjv: And Moses stretched out his hand over the sea; and the LORD caused the sea to go back by a strong east wind all that night, and made the sea dry land, and the waters were divided.
explanation: The LORD caused the sea to go back by a strong east wind all that night.

question: What happened to Pharaoh's army when the waters returned?
ref_kjv: And the waters returned, and covered the chariots, and the horsemen, and all the host of Pharaoh that came into the sea after them; there remained not so much as one of them.
explanation: The waters returned and covered the chariots, the horsemen and all the host of Pharaoh.

question: Where did Moses make bitter waters sweet soon after the crossing?
ref_kjv: And when they came to Marah, they could not drink of the waters of Marah, for they were bitter: therefore the name of it was called Marah. And the people murmured against Moses, saying, What shall we drink? And he cried unto the LORD; and the LORD shewed him a tree, which when he had cast into the waters, the waters were made sweet: there he made for them a statute and an ordinance, and there he proved them,
explanation: The waters of Marah were bitter; Moses cast a tree into them and they were made sweet.

question: Whose armour did David try on before facing Goliath?
ref_kjv: And Saul armed David with his armour, and he put an helmet of brass upon his head; also he armed him with a coat of mail. And David girded his sword upon his armour, and he assayed to go; for he had not proved it. And David said unto Saul, I cannot go with these; for I have not proved them. And David put them off him.
explanation: Saul armed David with his armour, but David put it off because he had not proved it.

question: What did David leave with a keeper when he went to the camp?
ref_kjv: And David rose up early in the morning, and left the sheep with a keeper, and took, and went, as Jesse had commanded him; and he came to the trench, as the host was going forth to the fight, and shouted for the battle.
explanation: David rose early and left the sheep with a keeper.

question: Where did David's stone strike Goliath?
ref_kjv: And David put his hand in his bag, and took thence a stone, and slang it, and smote the Philistine in his forehead, that the stone sunk into his forehead; and he fell upon his face to the earth.
explanation: The stone sank into the Philistine's forehead, and he fell upon his face.

question: Who was Solomon's father?
ref_kjv: Then sat Solomon upon the throne of David his father; and his kingdom was established greatly.
explanation: Solomon sat upon the throne of David his father.

question: How many years did Solomon spend building the temple?
ref_kjv: And in the eleventh year, in the month Bul, which is the eighth month, was the house finished throughout all the parts thereof, and according to all the fashion of it. So was he seven years in building it.
explanation: "So was he seven years in building it."

question: Which king of Tyre sent cedar and fir timber for the temple?
ref_kjv: And Hiram sent to Solomon, saying, I have considered the things which thou sentest to me for: and I will do all thy desire concerning timber of cedar, and concerning timber of fir. My servants shall bring them down from Lebanon unto the sea: and I will convey them by sea in floats unto the place that thou shalt appoint me, and will cause them to be discharged there, and thou shalt receive them: and thou shalt accomplish my desire, in giving food for my household. So Hiram gave Solomon cedar trees and fir trees according to all his desire.
explanation: Hiram gave Solomon cedar trees and fir trees according to all his desire.

question: On Carmel Elijah asked, "How long halt ye between two..."
ref_kjv: And Elijah came unto all the people, and said, How long halt ye between two opinions? if the LORD be God, follow him: but if Baal, then follow him. And the people answered him not a word.
explanation: "How long halt ye between two opinions? if the LORD be God, follow him."

question: What did Elijah have poured over the sacrifice on Mount Carmel?
ref_kjv: And he put the wood in order, and cut the bullock in pieces, and laid him on the wood, and said, Fill four barrels with water, and pour it on the burnt sacrifice, and on the wood. And he said, Do it the second time. And they did it the second time. And he said, Do it the third time. And they did it the third time. And the water ran round about the altar; and he filled the trench also with water.
explanation: Barrels of water were poured on the sacrifice three times until the trench was filled.

question: How many stones did Elijah use to build the altar on Carmel?
ref_kjv: And Elijah took twelve stones, according to the number of the tribes of the sons of Jacob, unto whom the word of the LORD came, saying, Israel shall be thy name:
explanation: Elijah took twelve stones, according to the number of the tribes of the sons of Jacob.

question: Why was Daniel cast into the den of lions?
options: He kept praying to his God despite the king's decree
He would not bow to a golden image
He read the writing on the wall
answer: He kept praying to his God despite the king's decree
ref_kjv: Then answered they and said before the king, That Daniel, which is of the children of the captivity of Judah, regardeth not thee, O king, nor the decree that thou hast signed, but maketh his petition three times a day.
explanation: His accusers said Daniel regarded not the king's decree but made his petition three times a day.

question: What was laid upon the mouth of the den and sealed?
ref_kjv: And a stone was brought, and laid upon the mouth of the den; and the king sealed it with his own signet, and with the signet of his lords; that the purpose might not be changed concerning Daniel.
explanation: A stone was laid upon the mouth of the den, and the king sealed it with his own signet.

question: What did the king do very early the next morning?
options: Went in haste to the den
answer: Went in haste to the den
ref_kjv: Then the king arose very early in the morning, and went in haste unto the den of lions.
explanation: The king arose very early in the morning and went in haste unto the den of lions.

question: Which queen refused to come at King Ahasuerus' command?
ref_kjv: But the queen Vashti refused to come at the king’s commandment by his chamberlains: therefore was the king very wroth, and his anger burned in him.
explanation: Queen Vashti refused to come at the king's commandment.

question: On what was Haman hanged?
options: The gallows he had made for Mordecai
A tree in the king's garden
answer: The gallows he had made for Mordecai
ref_kjv: So they hanged Haman on the gallows that he had prepared for Mordecai. Then was the king’s wrath pacified.
explanation: They hanged Haman on the gallows that he had prepared for Mordecai.

question: What did Esther ask the Jews in Shushan to do before she went to the king?
ref_kjv: Go, gather together all the Jews that are present in Shushan, and fast ye for me, and neither eat nor drink three days, night or day: I also and my maidens will fast likewise; and so will I go in unto the king, which is not according to the law: and if I perish, I perish.
explanation: Esther said, "Fast ye for me... three days, night or day."

question: What name did the angel tell Joseph to give the child?
ref_kjv: And she shall bring forth a son, and thou shalt call his name JESUS: for he shall save his people from their sins.
explanation: "Thou shalt call his name JESUS: for he shall save his people from their sins."

question: What went before the wise men and stood over where the young child was?
ref_kjv: When they had heard the king, they departed; and, lo, the star, which they saw in the east, went before them, till it came and stood over where the young child was.
explanation: The star went before them, till it came and stood over where the young child was.

question: To which land did Joseph take Mary and the child to escape Herod?
ref_kjv: When he arose, he took the young child and his mother by night, and departed into Egypt:
explanation: Joseph took the young child and his mother by night and departed into Egypt.

question: "Blessed are the peacemakers: for they shall be called..."
ref_kjv: Blessed are the peacemakers: for they shall be called the children of God.
explanation: "Blessed are the peacemakers: for they shall be called the children of God."

question: Where did Jesus say to lay up treasures?
ref_kjv: But lay up for yourselves treasures in heaven, where neither moth nor rust doth corrupt, and where thieves do not break through nor steal:
explanation: "Lay up for yourselves treasures in heaven."

question: Jesus said to consider which things, that toil not, neither spin?
ref_kjv: And why take ye thought for raiment? Consider the lilies of the field, how they grow; they toil not, neither do they spin:
explanation: "Consider the lilies of the field, how they grow; they toil not, neither do they spin."

question: What was Jesus doing when the storm arose?
ref_kjv: And he was in the hinder part of the ship, asleep on a pillow: and they awake him, and say unto him, Master, carest thou not that we perish?
explanation: Jesus was in the hinder part of the ship, asleep on a pillow.

question: What did the disciples say when they woke Jesus?
options: Master, carest thou not that we perish?
answer: Master, carest thou not that we perish?
ref_kjv: And he was in the hinder part of the ship, asleep on a pillow: and they awake him, and say unto him, Master, carest thou not that we perish?
explanation: They woke Him and said, "Master, carest thou not that we perish?"

question: What happened when Jesus rebuked the wind?
ref_kjv: And he arose, and rebuked the wind, and said unto the sea, Peace, be still. And the wind ceased, and there was a great calm.
explanation: The wind ceased, and there was a great calm.

question: What did the disciples ask one another afterwards?
options: What manner of man is this?
answer: What manner of man is this?
ref_kjv: And they feared exceedingly, and said one to another, What manner of man is this, that even the wind and the sea obey him?
explanation: "What manner of man is this, that even the wind and the sea obey him?"

question: On what did the Samaritan set the wounded man?
ref_kjv: And went to him, and bound up his wounds, pouring in oil and wine, and set him on his own beast, and brought him to an inn, and took care of him.
explanation: He set him on his own beast and brought him to an inn.

question: Whom did the lawyer name as the true neighbour?
options: He that shewed mercy on him
answer: He that shewed mercy on him
ref_kjv: And he said, He that shewed mercy on him. Then said Jesus unto him, Go, and do thou likewise.
explanation: The lawyer said, "He that shewed mercy on him." Jesus said, "Go, and do thou likewise."

question: What did the younger son ask his father to give him?
ref_kjv: And the younger of them said to his father, Father, give me the portion of goods that falleth to me. And he divided unto them his living.
explanation: "Father, give me the portion of goods that falleth to me."

question: What would the son gladly have eaten while feeding swine?
ref_kjv: And he would fain have filled his belly with the husks that the swine did eat: and no man gave unto him.
explanation: He would fain have filled his belly with the husks that the swine did eat.

question: What did the father do when he saw his son a great way off?
options: Ran and fell on his neck
answer: Ran and fell on his neck
ref_kjv: And he arose, and came to his father. But when he was yet a great way off, his father saw him, and had compassion, and ran, and fell on his neck, and kissed him.
explanation: The father had compassion, and ran, and fell on his neck, and kissed him.

question: What sound came from heaven on the day of Pentecost?
ref_kjv: And suddenly there came a sound from heaven as of a rushing mighty wind, and it filled all the house where they were sitting.
explanation: Suddenly there came a sound from heaven as of a rushing mighty wind.

question: With what were they all filled?
ref_kjv: And they were all filled with the Holy Ghost, and began to speak with other tongues, as the Spirit gave them utterance.
explanation: They were all filled with the Holy Ghost and began to speak with other tongues.

question: Which prophet did Peter quote in his sermon?
ref_kjv: But this is that which was spoken by the prophet Joel;
explanation: Peter said, "This is that which was spoken by the prophet Joel."

question: What was the name of the centurion who had charge of Paul?
ref_kjv: And when it was determined that we should sail into Italy, they delivered Paul and certain other prisoners unto one named Julius, a centurion of Augustus’ band.
explanation: Paul was delivered unto one named Julius, a centurion of Augustus' band.

question: How many souls were in the ship?
ref_kjv: And we were in all in the ship two hundred threescore and sixteen souls.
explanation: "We were in all in the ship two hundred threescore and sixteen souls."

question: During the storm, what did Paul urge everyone on the ship to be?
ref_kjv: And now I exhort you to be of good cheer: for there shall be no loss of any man’s life among you, but of the ship.
explanation: Paul said, "I exhort you to be of good cheer: for there shall be no loss of any man's life."

question: What was Jonah doing in the ship during the storm?
ref_kjv: Then the mariners were afraid, and cried every man unto his god, and cast forth the wares that were in the ship into the sea, to lighten it of them. But Jonah was gone down into the sides of the ship; and he lay, and was fast asleep.
explanation: Jonah was gone down into the sides of the ship; and he lay, and was fast asleep.

question: How did the people of Nineveh respond to Jonah's warning?
options: They fasted and put on sackcloth
answer: They fasted and put on sackcloth
ref_kjv: So the people of Nineveh believed God, and proclaimed a fast, and put on sackcloth, from the greatest of them even to the least of them.
explanation: The people of Nineveh believed God, proclaimed a fast and put on sackcloth.

question: What did the fish do when the LORD spoke to it?
options: Vomited Jonah out upon the dry land
answer: Vomited Jonah out upon the dry land
ref_kjv: And the LORD spake unto the fish, and it vomited out Jonah upon the dry land.
explanation: "The LORD spake unto the fish, and it vomited out Jonah upon the dry land."

question: What did the women find had been rolled away?
ref_kjv: And when they looked, they saw that the stone was rolled away: for it was very great.
explanation: They saw that the stone was rolled away: for it was very great.

question: What did the angel tell the women about Jesus?
ref_kjv: He is not here: for he is risen, as he said. Come, see the place where the Lord lay.
explanation: "He is not here: for he is risen, as he said."

question: Who ran with Peter to the tomb and got there first?
options: The other disciple, whom Jesus loved
answer: The other disciple, whom Jesus loved
ref_kjv: Then she runneth, and cometh to Simon Peter, and to the other disciple, whom Jesus loved, and saith unto them, They have taken away the Lord out of the sepulchre, and we know not where they have laid him. Peter therefore went forth, and that other disciple, and came to the sepulchre. So they ran both together: and the other disciple did outrun Peter, and came first to the sepulchre.
explanation: The other disciple, whom Jesus loved, did outrun Peter and came first to the sepulchre.
